lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Your shooter's been asking after a number. Four hundred and one.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Everything the Basin washed down comes out here. If there was ever a list, it's in the water — and so is whoever was carrying it, which is why nobody's gone looking.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Eleven days I've counted them. Not one name. I would like one name.

choices.text: Then we go into the water.
